svg.text: Ray + vLLM + DeepSpeed - Agent-Based RLHF / RLVR - arXiv:2405.11143
Separate GPU pools per model - 70B+ scale
L3 - Ray Model Workers & Agent Executors
Ray separates or colocates models - AgentExecutor produces token trajectories fed to decoupled RL algorithms
Recommended default: colocate_all on same GPUs - avoids 50% idle clock waste
Phase 1: Generation - vLLM awake (KV cache + weights), DeepSpeed engines asleep
Phase 2: AgentExecutor token trajectories - reward scoring - advantage compute
Phase 3: NCCL weight sync - actor weights broadcast to vLLM engines
Phase 4: vLLM sleep - DeepSpeed wake - actor/critic/ref/reward forward+backward+optim
Repeat - timing metrics: generation / make_experience / ppo_train / broadcast / step_total
Distributed mode: separate GPU pools per model - pipelines for 70B+ when memory tight
First RLHF framework with unified token-in-token-out agent paradigm
Any algo works with any agent mode
train.async_enable - bounded queue overlaps gen + train
Mutually exclusive with vLLM sleep mode
partial_rollout_enable - pause in-flight, swap weights, resume
Pair with is_correction_enable icepop for off-policy noise
Used by Magistral, ProRL V2, ScaleRL, CMU NLP course - v0.10.4 production-ready
Logging: wandb / tensorboard - ckpt load/save - best_metric_key - multi-node Ray + SLURM
70B+ models - NVIDIA NGC Docker - multi-node Ray/SLURM - native HF checkpoints - no model conversion
Init path: ray start cluster - ray job submit train_ppo_ray - init Actor/Critic/Reward/Ref/vLLM on placement groups
Step path: agent rollout (vLLM) - reward - advantage - NCCL sync - DeepSpeed update - sleep/wake cycle
Sources: OpenRLHF/OpenRLHF README - openrlhf.readthedocs.io architecture + hybrid_engine - arXiv:2405.11143
